## Prepare Data

```{r}
nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg$fumbles_lost <- rowSums(nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg[,c("sack_fumbles_lost","rushing_fumbles_lost","receiving_fumbles_lost")])

faVars <- c(
  "passing_yards","passing_tds","passing_interceptions","passing_epa","passing_cpoe",
  "rushing_yards","rushing_tds","rushing_epa",
  "receiving_epa","fumbles_lost"
)
```

# Correlation Matrix

```{r}
petersenlab::cor.table(
  nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg[,faVars]
)

GGally::ggcorr(
  nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg[,faVars],
  label = TRUE,
  label_round = 2)
```

# Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA)

## Determine Number of Factors

Determine the number of factors to retain.

### Scree Plots

```{r}
psych::fa.parallel(
  x = nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg[faVars],
  fm = "ml",
  fa = "fa"
)

screeDataEFA <- nFactors::nScree(
  x = cor(
    nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg[faVars],
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
  model = "factors")

nFactors::plotnScree(screeDataEFA)
```

### Very Simple Structure (VSS) Plot

```{r}
psych::vss(
  nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg[faVars],
  rotate = "oblimin",
  fm = "mle")

psych::nfactors(
  nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg[faVars],
  rotate = "oblimin",
  fm = "mle")
```

## Fit Models

```{r}
efa_fit <- lavaan::efa(
  data = nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg,
  ov.names = faVars,
  nfactors = 1:3,
  rotation = "geomin",
  missing = "ML",
  estimator = "MLR",
  bounds = "standard",
  meanstructure = TRUE,
  em.h1.iter.max = 2000000)

summary(efa_fit)
```

## Plot Models

```{r}
lavaanPlot::lavaanPlot(
  efa_fit$nf1,
  coefs = TRUE,
  #covs = TRUE,
  stand = TRUE)

lavaanPlot::lavaanPlot(
  efa_fit$nf2,
  coefs = TRUE,
  #covs = TRUE,
  stand = TRUE)

lavaanPlot::lavaanPlot(
  efa_fit$nf3,
  coefs = TRUE,
  #covs = TRUE,
  stand = TRUE)
```

## Fit 1-Factor EFA Model

To identify the best overall offense, let's retain one factor.
If we kept more than one factor, we could distinguish between the best passing game, running game, etc.

```{r}
efa1factor_syntax <- '
 # EFA Factor Loadings
 efa("efa1")*f1 =~ passing_yards + passing_tds + passing_interceptions + passing_epa + passing_cpoe + 
 rushing_yards + rushing_tds + rushing_epa + receiving_epa + fumbles_lost
'

efa1factor_fit <- sem(
  efa1factor_syntax,
  data = nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg,
  information = "observed",
  missing = "ML",
  estimator = "MLR",
  rotation = "geomin",
  bounds = "standard",
  meanstructure = TRUE,
  em.h1.iter.max = 2000000)

summary(
  efa1factor_fit,
  fit.measures = TRUE,
  standardized = TRUE,
  rsquare = TRUE)
```

## Plot 1-Factor EFA Model

```{r}
lavaanPlot::lavaanPlot(
  efa1factor_fit,
  coefs = TRUE,
  covs = TRUE,
  stand = TRUE)
```

## Factor Scores

```{r}
efa1factor_factorScores <- lavaan::lavPredict(efa1factor_fit)

nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg <- cbind(nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg, efa1factor_factorScores)
```

## Identify the Best and Worst Offenses

### Best Offenses

Which teams (in a given season) have had the best offense?

```{r}
nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg %>% 
  arrange(-f1) %>% 
  select(season, team, f1, all_of(faVars)) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  head()
```

### Worst Offenses

Which teams (in a given season) have had the worst offense?

```{r}
nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg %>% 
  arrange(f1) %>% 
  select(season, team, f1, all_of(faVars)) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  head()
```

# Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA)

## Fit Model

To identify the best overall offense, let's retain one factor.
If we kept more than one factor, we could distinguish between the best passing game, running game, etc.

```{r}
cfa1factor_syntax <- '
 #Factor loadings
 F1 =~ passing_yards + passing_tds + passing_interceptions + passing_epa + passing_cpoe + 
 rushing_yards + rushing_tds + rushing_epa + receiving_epa + fumbles_lost
'

cfa1factor_fit <- lavaan::cfa(
  cfa1factor_syntax,
  data = nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg,
  missing = "ML",
  estimator = "MLR",
  bounds = "standard",
  std.lv = TRUE,
  em.h1.iter.max = 2000000)

summary(
  cfa1factor_fit,
  fit.measures = TRUE,
  standardized = TRUE,
  rsquare = TRUE)
```

## Plot 1-Factor EFA Model

```{r}
lavaanPlot::lavaanPlot(
  cfa1factor_fit,
  coefs = TRUE,
  covs = TRUE,
  stand = TRUE)
```

## Factor Scores

```{r}
cfa1factor_factorScores <- lavaan::lavPredict(cfa1factor_fit)

nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg <- cbind(nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg, cfa1factor_factorScores)
```

## Identify the Best and Worst Offenses

### Best Offenses

Which teams (in a given season) have had the best offense?

```{r}
nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg %>% 
  arrange(-F1) %>% 
  select(season, team, F1, all_of(faVars)) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  head()
```

### Worst Offenses

Which teams (in a given season) have had the worst offense?

```{r}
nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg %>% 
  arrange(F1) %>% 
  select(season, team, F1, all_of(faVars)) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  head()
```
